notes:
kr8 0.4.3 — take your own relay public without starting over.

- A relay you host on this computer can now be moved to a public address (for example relay.kr8.dev through a Cloudflare Tunnel) so your phone can reach it and pair with it. Your community keeps its members, history, files and invites; kr8 takes a backup first and puts everything back if a step fails.
- This computer follows the move by itself: agents, saved messages, boards, read markers, invites and settings carry over to the new address.
- Find it under the relay's Manage pane: "Make this relay reachable from your phone".
